description: This file defines utility functions within the Utils namespace to validate whether a given string represents a valid integer or unsigned integer. It includes functions isValidInt and isValidUnsignedInt that check the characters of the input string to determine validity.

methods.name: isValidInt
methods.description: Checks if the input string represents a valid integer, allowing for an optional leading minus sign.

methods.name: isValidUnsignedInt
methods.description: Checks if the input string represents a valid unsigned integer, consisting solely of digits.
